title: Soyeht engine and client protocol
description: Wire schema. x-methods and x-events associate JSON-RPC names with schemas. See README.md for supported vocabulary.

PromptAttachmentKind.description: What the client attached. The engine checks it against mimeType and chooses the ACP content block from the agent's promptCapabilities.

PromptAttachment.description: A file sent with a prompt. A request carries exactly one source: attachmentId (bytes sent as type-3 frames before the request), data (inline bytes) or path (a file already on the engine host). Queued prompts and transcript messages carry the engine-owned path instead, never data or attachmentId.

thumbnail.description: A small PNG or JPEG preview made by the client and kept with the transcript.

texts.harnessSwitchHandover: This starts a new agent session. Recent messages and pending prompts are handed over as historical data.
